summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the declared Versioning + Lineage Engine contract: it registers append-only object versions, creates typed lineage nodes, records explicit impact edges, computes lineage graphs and rebuild manifests from registered references, and rejects malformed or cyclic input without taking ownership of quality, truth, phase approval, source freshness, or downstream operational decisions.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Conformance smoke checks covered the documented update happy path, sparse first-version create, malformed input rejection with no partial registry write, causal cycle rejection, and duplicate impact edge idempotency.
test_results.notes: Checks executed against artifacts/implementation/codebase/versioning_lineage_engine.py using scenarios derived from test_spec.md and the usage example. No contract, boundary, metadata, separation, or test-blocking issue was observed.
